```swift extension MyTextFormattingDefinition { struct Scope: AttributeScope { /* ... */ let foregroundColor: AttributeScopes.SwiftUIAttributes.ForegroundColorAttribute let backgroundColor: AttributeScopes.SwiftUIAttributes.BackgroundColorAttribute } } struct NoEqualForegroundAndBackground: AttributedTextValueConstraint { typealias Scope = MyTextFormattingDefinition.Scope typealias AttributeKey = AttributeScopes.SwiftUIAttributes.BackgroundColorAttribute func constrain( _ container: inout Attributes ) { if let color = container.foregroundColor, container.backgroundColor == color { container.backgroundColor = nil } } } ```

```swift /// Makes the background color for all Genmoji blue. /// /// - Note: This constraint depends on a valid adaptiveImageGlyph value. struct BlueGenmojiBackgroundConstraint<Scope: AttributeScope>: AttributedTextValueConstraint { typealias AttributeKey = AttributeScopes.SwiftUIAttributes .BackgroundColorAttribute func constrain( _ container: inout Attributes ) { if container[ AttributeScopes.SwiftUIAttributes.AdaptiveImageGlyphAttribute.self ] != nil { container.backgroundColor = .blue } } } ```
